name: Crimson Roses
source:
A man lost his wife forever, mystery surrounds his life. Ignorant for now, the protagonist uncovers all those mysteries about his powers, origin and the death of his beloved wife.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/crimsonroses]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一个男人永远失去了妻子，重重谜团笼罩着他的生活。此刻仍一无所知的主人公，将逐一揭开关于自身力量、身世，以及爱妻之死的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/crimsonroses]Patreon[/url]]
